decisions.reason: The existing same-message FAQ MODIFY already captures conditional winner emails and email guidance for viewing or converting the prize; no additional change is required.
Conditional prize-winner emails and their guidance do not change the requirement to display awarded ticket counts in the dashboard.
The winner-email decision does not alter the landing-page mechanics or prize-promotional copy.
Emailing prize winners does not change how referral commissions appear in the dashboard.
The prize-winner notification rules do not change the hero headline, mechanics preview, call to action, or emphasized selling points.
Winner-email eligibility and guidance do not change the public counter for sales remaining until the next draw.
The notification-email decision has no effect on displaying or positioning the book cover.
Prize-winner email behavior does not change the hero layout, message prominence, or book-cover integration.
The email-notification modification does not alter the requirement for uncropped mobile stacking of statistics and mechanics.
Prize-winner notifications are distinct from the mint-confirmation certificate email and do not change its contents, actions, or read-link destination.
The source adds conditional email notification and explanatory guidance but does not change the existing automatic direct-wallet payout or Winners-page announcement behavior.
Adding prize-winner email content does not change the established Brevo transactional-email provider.
